sources.title: Lieb-Robinson bounds and the generation of correlations and topological quantum order
sources.read_scope: Full primary PDF, local time-dependent Hamiltonian assumptions, commutator bound, equation (2) conditional-expectation truncation, GHZ preparation example and notes 11-12
sources.supports: Local bounded Hamiltonians have effective light cones with exponential tails; truncation by partial trace and circuit/state-preparation resource bounds are standard physics
sources.does_not_support: A new GRUT principle, an independently calibrated velocity for this audit's experimental device, or a strict Hamiltonian light cone without tails

sources.title: Observation of Quantum Darwinism and the Origin of Classicality with Superconducting Circuits
sources.read_scope: Main text, especially supplied conditional gates, initial states, pointer basis, auxiliary-environment scrambling, Figure 3 and information measures; supplementary experimental methods accessible in the same primary HTML
sources.supports: A primary experimental record-control context with explicit supplied preparations and environmental interactions; quantum mutual information, Holevo information and local readout must be distinguished
sources.does_not_support: Our universal shallow-circuit bound, a demonstrated lock on a specific available platform, Born-outcome selection, or generation of the system/environment split

novelty_assessment: All restrictions here are standard unitary quantum mechanics plus supplied locality, preparation and resource ceilings. The displayed capacity bound is a direct light-cone application. No new GRUT generating law or observable exclusion beyond that baseline is established.
